text: Going from N=128 to N=256 on matched seeds 22-23, the force random-control R2 rises by 0.024-0.040 while trained force R2 falls by only 0.021-0.044. Over every matched seed at N=64/128/256 under the current pipeline, how much of the force-margin decline comes from rising force controls and how much from falling trained R2? Would a control pool shared across N remove most of the N=128-to-N=256 drop?
